tool_schemas.name: Optional Settings
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves or updates MCP settings at the requested scope: action=get returns the current settings record, and action=update applies the provided fields and returns the updated record. Updating validates field types and ranges (e.g., request_timeout_ms >= 0, max_concurrent_requests >= 1), requires user_id when scope=user, and returns NOT_FOUND if scope=user and the referenced user settings record does not exist. Returns UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot read or modify the targeted scope, and CONFLICT if default_server_id is set to a server that is not linked/accessible for that scope or if status=disabled blocks the requested update.

action.description: Operation to perform on MCP settings (retrieve current or update fields).

user_id.description: User ULID (required when scope is user).

auth_mode.description: Authentication mode the MCP server should use.

default_server_id.description: Default linked Supabase server (project/environment) to use.

redact_secrets_in_logs.description: Whether to redact secrets (tokens/keys) in logs.

request_timeout_ms.description: Request timeout in milliseconds for outbound Supabase API calls.

max_concurrent_requests.description: Maximum number of concurrent outbound requests allowed.

status.description: Whether this settings record is active.

body.description: Fields to update on the targeted settings record (only for action=update).

tool_schemas.name: Who Am I
tool_schemas.description: Returns the authenticated caller identity, granted scopes, and current quota/rate-limit consumption. Refuses requests with missing or invalid credentials.

credential.description: Bearer access token or API key presented to authenticate the call.

tool_schemas.name: Users
tool_schemas.description: Lists users or fetches a single user by id. list supports filtering by status/email and returns a paginated result set; get returns the user record or NOT_FOUND.

action.description: Operation to perform on users (list or fetch by id).

credential.description: Bearer access token or API key presented to authenticate the call.

status.description: Filter by user lifecycle status (only for action=list).

email.description: Filter by exact email match (only for action=list).

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return (only for action=list).

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous list response (only for action=list).

tool_schemas.name: Supabase Servers
tool_schemas.description: Lists, fetches, creates, or updates linked Supabase servers (projects/environments) visible to the authenticated user. create enforces unique (owner_user_id, supabase_project_ref) and requires an active owning user; update validates fields and lifecycle status transitions and refuses updates to revoked servers.

action.description: Operation to perform on Supabase servers.

credential.description: Bearer access token or API key presented to authenticate the call.

id.description: Supabase server ULID (required for action=get and action=update).

owner_user_id.description: Filter by owner user id (only for action=list).

supabase_project_ref.description: Filter by Supabase project ref (only for action=list).

status.description: Filter by server lifecycle status (only for action=list).

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return (only for action=list).

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous list response (only for action=list).

supabase_project_ref.description: Supabase project ref to link (required for action=create).

name.description: Friendly name for the linked project/environment.

api_base_url.description: Base URL for Supabase API calls for this project/environment.

region.description: Region identifier for the project/environment (e.g., us-east-1).

status.description: Lifecycle status update (must follow allowed transitions; revoked is terminal).

body.description: Fields to set on create or update. For create, owner_user_id and supabase_project_ref are required.

tool_schemas.name: Credentials
tool_schemas.description: Lists, fetches, creates, or updates stored credentials used for Supabase authentication. create accepts secret material for encryption (never stored in plaintext) and returns the credential metadata; update supports label/expires_at changes and lifecycle transitions (active→rotated/revoked; rotated→revoked). Revoking a credential also revokes all active auth sessions referencing it.

credential.description: Bearer access token or API key presented to authenticate the call.

id.description: Credential ULID (required for action=get and action=update).

user_id.description: Filter by owning user id (only for action=list).

type.description: Filter by credential type (only for action=list).

status.description: Filter by credential lifecycle status (only for action=list).

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return (only for action=list).

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous list response (only for action=list).

secret_plaintext.description: Secret material to encrypt and store (only accepted on action=create; never returned).

expires_at.description: Optional expiration timestamp for the credential.

status.description: Lifecycle status update (must follow allowed transitions).

body.description: Fields to set on create or update. For create, user_id, type, and secret_plaintext are required.

tool_schemas.name: Auth Sessions
tool_schemas.description: Lists, fetches, creates, updates, or revokes auth sessions for the authenticated user. create issues a new session if settings/auth_mode permit: when auth_mode is pat/oauth, an active compatible credential must exist (credential_id required unless auth_mode=none). update supports transitioning active sessions to revoked; sessions automatically expire when expires_at <= now and cannot be reactivated.

action.description: Operation to perform on auth sessions.

credential.description: Bearer access token or API key presented to authenticate the call.

id.description: Session ULID (required for action=get and action=update).

user_id.description: Filter by user id (only for action=list; defaults to the caller where applicable).

status.description: Filter by session lifecycle status (only for action=list).

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return (only for action=list).

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous list response (only for action=list).

user_id.description: User ULID to issue the session for (required for action=create unless inferred from caller).

credential_id.description: Credential ULID to bind to the session (required for action=create when auth_mode is pat/oauth).

status.description: Lifecycle status update. Only active→revoked is accepted by update; expired/revoked are terminal.

body.description: Fields to set on create or update. Creating validates expires_at and refuses active sessions with revoked_at set or expires_at in the past.

metadata.name: Supabase MCP Server
metadata.description: This backend stores Supabase MCP Server sign-in configuration and the set of reachable Supabase "servers" (projects/environments) a user can manage after authentication. The primary workflow is: configure optional settings, authenticate, register accessible Supabase projects, and keep an audit trail
